cmd:
# Start gitea via systemd
sudo systemctl enable gitea
sudo systemctl start gitea
sleep 3
sudo systemctl status gitea --no-pager | head -15
echo '---'
# Test if it's responding
curl -s http://localhost:3000/ -o /dev/null -w 'HTTP %{http_code}' 2>&1
echo ''
curl -s http://localhost:3000/api/v1/version 2>&1
